data.name: Nomad Knight: Blunt Blade Theory
data.detailed_description:
Directional Melee Action RPG

Action RPG with a directional melee combat. No automated fights, no hand holding. Your survival depends entirely on your positioning, directional attacking, and timing. Chose your attacking direction based on your character's movement; parry at the right time or dodgeroll to defend yourself. Kick them to disorient, breaking their defenses or to throw them on spikes for environmental damage. It is all up to you and your skills!

Train Your Mind And Body:

3 Different stats to chose from when leveling up; HP, Breath and Damage. Pick whichever you think is important and make your own builds on different runs!

Chose Your Gear:

4 different types of weapons and 4 different visual styles of those 4 different types; in total 16 weapons, each style also favoring different passive stats.

One handed Sword: Fastest weapon type with decent Reach and decent Parry window. Favors your Breath stat; so you can do more actions!

Sword And Shield: Best Defense with largest Parry window with decent speed and range. Favors your HP stat; so you can endure more!

Greatsword: Best Range and Reach with decent Parry window for more balanced gameplay. Favors your HP and Damage stats!

Dual Swords: Best Offense with better Parry window and wider effective area. Favors your Damage stat; so you can slay more!

Also 6 different armors: Light Armors making Dodging easier; while Heavy Armors providing more defence.

Immersive First Person or Third Person Cameras:

Immersive First Person Camera with full body motions; or more action oriented Third Person Camera. Pick the one you want, anytime you want!

Choose Your Fate:

ARPG Difficulty: Perfect for players who want to master the mechanics at their own pace. Explore, farm, upgrade and conquer without the fear of losing your hard earned golds, materials and levels.

Roguelite Difficulty: Die, adapt and repeat. You keep your unlocked armors and weapons, but dieing strips away your unspent golds, materials and zone progress. Can you defeat the Renegade Lord in a single clean run?

Solo Developer:

This game is being worked on by a Single Developer. Around 90% of the work has been done by the same person.

data.short_description: ARPG with a directional melee combat; time-based parrying and dodgerolling, 3 stats when leveling, Normal aRPG and Roguelite modes, 4 different types of weapons (16 total weapons) and 6 different armors, a compact open world for you to explore; and a mission to kill the Renegade Lord of the Citadel.
